title: CSS Level 1
note: The first CSS recommendation describes how a browser applies style rules to a structured document.

title: XML 1.0
note: This edition specifies the syntax for XML documents, including elements, attributes and well-formedness.

title: HTML 4.01
note: This HTML edition describes document structure, forms and presentation, including style sheets.

title: SVG 1.0
note: SVG defines a language for describing two-dimensional graphics in XML.

title: WCAG 2.0
note: This edition groups accessibility guidance under four principles and specifies testable success criteria.

title: HTML5
note: The HTML5 recommendation defines HTML elements and APIs including canvas, video and audio.

title: WCAG 2.2
note: This edition adds criteria covering topics such as focus visibility, dragging movements and target size.
